_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. Equals' public surface is three sites: the equals.com marketing pages (light only, --brand-* palette and .accent--*/.label--* body themes), the go.equals.com sign-in card (light, --color-* Tailwind-style ramps) and the docs.equals.com Mintlify docs (light and dark, --primary/--gray-*/--background-* semantics). Declared scales under core.*; the marketing and sign-in roles under light.*; the docs roles under both light.* and dark.* (Mintlify's dark is a real theme). Measured roles alias the declared values they match.
